## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the small rounded plastic mouse and set it on the Red mat.

Task description: The object is the dark, rounded plastic mouse to the left of the toothbrush. Pick it up and place it on the red rectangular mat at the lower left of the image.

Success criteria: The mouse is near the center of the red mat, lying flat with its long axis aligned to the mat's long edge. Both grippers are open and have released the mouse.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above and grasp opposing middle sidewalls across the mouse's short axis, opening slightly wider than that section. Confirm the pads surround both sides before closing, avoiding pressure only on the domed top that could slip.
- If the orientation needs adjustment, rotate the mouse while it is off the table and there is clearance around it, leaving room for the fingers to sweep clear of the blue package on the left and toothbrush on the right.
- The lower edge of the red mat is cut off in the current view. Use the live view to confirm its full boundary rather than mistaking the center of the visible part for the center of the whole mat.
- During placement, let the mouse base rest on the mat before slowly releasing, then withdraw the fingers upward. Avoid releasing while suspended and shifting it, or dragging it during withdrawal.
